decisions.choice: Legal bodies are MDX loaded through the existing compileMDX pipeline; dedicated app/legal/* pages own their slugs and the catch-all and sitemap skip them
decisions.justification: app/(content)/[...slug]/page.tsx:15-18 and app/sitemap.ts:10-19 would otherwise duplicate routes and list drafts

decisions.choice: ALLOW_DRAFT_LEGAL gate runs in `build` (apps/site/package.json build script) and is set only for CI build and preview, not for the main production deploy; the site.yml build artifact is shared by both, so the workflow needs a separate production build step or gate
decisions.justification: site.yml deploy job downloads one site-out artifact for main and PR previews; issue says production build must fail on drafts

decisions.choice: Chrome i18n lives in apps/site/lib/legal-chrome.ts, not packages/i18n
decisions.justification: The site has no i18n wiring and must not depend on app packages; no CLAUDE.md registry applies

decisions.choice: Issue's '(+ stories)' is not delivered: apps/site has no Storybook, and adding it is outside the issue's acceptance criteria; components reuse packages/ui primitives
decisions.justification: no .storybook under apps/site; checks.mjs/CLAUDE.md forbid running Storybook locally

decisions.choice: DPA links to /security/ although that page is owned by #91 and not yet present
decisions.justification: Issue requires the link; #91 (L03) creates the page. e2e asserts the href only, not the target

decisions.choice: Counsel text is TODO placeholders only; effectiveDate is omitted for drafts
decisions.justification: Issue Security and conduct: effective date set only when counsel approves; legal wording is out of scope
